summary: Ge2Sb2Te5 (GST) thin films were deposited using Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) with a novel alkylsilyl tellurium precursor. The films showed excellent conformality and phase change characteristics comparable to sputtered GST films. The study focused on the crystallization behavior, impurity content, and structural properties of the ALD GST films.
evidence: SbCl3, GeCl2/C1C4H8O2 and (Et3Si)2Te were evaporated inside the reactor at 30, 70 and 40 /C176C, respectively. The GST films were deposited at a substrate temperature of 90 /C176C. The crystallization of the ALD made GST films is in line with the behavior observed for sputtered GST, for example.
